lines.text: Your TV is across the room. TellyMote puts the remote in your hands, and the screen on your laptop.
One window: remote, live screen, and the numbers that prove it is working. Measured, not guessed.
Arrow keys move. Enter selects. Type a search on a real keyboard, instead of spelling it out letter by letter.
It finds Android TV, Google TV, and Roku on your own network. No account. No store in the middle.
The build is unsigned, so Windows warns you once. Every release ships with a SHA-two-five-six, or you can build it yourself.
Free on Windows, macOS and Linux. github dot com, slash Nathan K Sanal, slash tellymote.
